remainingLimitations: Fixed-step discontinuity times and sampled delay history need dt/history refinement.
Kapitza effective potential assumes fast/small forcing; Van der Pol can be stiff; Duffing softening can escape.
Mathieu multiplier tolerance is not a boundedness proof, particularly at repeated/Jordan multipliers.
Friction spring/block is an explicit Lab wrapper; Stribeck regularization affects comparison curve while actual trajectory uses Coulomb complementarity.
Pyragas continuation restarts the original configured observation duration from the current state/clock with required tail; it is not a remaining-run integrator object dump.
Large history may exceed share URL limits and requires JSON. Earlier S11–S13 scientific limitations remain documented.
